shellCommands.command: find /workspace -type f -not -path "*/node_modules/*" -not -path "*/.git/*" -not -path "*/.next/*" | head -100

cat node_modules/react/package.json 2>/dev/null | head -40; echo "---NEXT---"; cat node_modules/next/package.json 2>/dev/null | grep -E '"version"'; echo "---react version---"; node -e "console.log(require('react').version)" 2>&1
git diff package.json; echo "=== eval runner ==="; wc -l __agent_eval__/run.mjs

node -e "const r=require('react'); console.log(Object.keys(r).filter(k=>/ransition/i.test(k)))" 2>&1; echo "=== next files with viewTransition ==="; ls node_modules/next/ 2>/dev/null; echo "=== grep ==="; grep -rl "viewTransition\|ViewTransition" node_modules/next/*.js node_modules/next/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -20

grep -ro "viewTransition[A-Za-z]*" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-schema.js node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts 2>/dev/null | sort -u | head; echo "=== experimental dir ==="; ls node_modules/next/experimental/; echo "=== AGENTS.md ==="; head -60 node_modules/next/AGENTS.md
ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/ 2>/dev/null; echo "=== grep docs for transition ==="; grep -ril "view.transition" node_modules/next/dist/docs/ 2>/dev/null | head -20
cd /workspace; grep -rn "transitionTypes" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/02-components/link.md | head -20

cd /workspace; node -e "console.log(require('./node_modules/@types/react/package.json').version)"; echo "=== ViewTransition in @types/react ==="; grep -rn "ViewTransition" node_modules/@types/react/*.d.ts | head -20; echo "=== transitionTypes in next link types ==="; grep -rn "transitionTypes" node_modules/next/dist/client/link.d.ts node_modules/next/dist/client/app-dir/link.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head

cd /workspace; grep -n -A6 -B2 -i "view.transition" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/interactive-apps.md | head -60; echo "==== v16 upgrade ===="; grep -n -B3 -A8 -i "view.transition" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/upgrading/version-16.md | head -40

cd /workspace; grep -n "ViewTransition:" node_modules/@types/react/canary.d.ts; grep -n "const ViewTransition\|ViewTransition\b.*FunctionComponent\|ExoticComponent" node_modules/@types/react/canary.d.ts | head; echo "=== alias of react -> compiled ==="; grep -rn "compiled/react'" node_modules/next/dist/build/webpack-config.js 2>/dev/null | head -5; grep -rno "createRSCAliases\|'react\$'" node_modules/next/dist/build/webpack-config.js 2>/dev/null | head -5
npx next build 2>&1 | tail -40

cd /workspace; (npx next start -p 3111 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 6; echo "--- HOME ---"; curl -s localhost:3111 | grep -o 'view-transition-name:[^;"]*' | head; echo "--- HOME thumbnail markup ---"; curl -s localhost:3111 | grep -o '<div class="product-image"[^>]*>' | head -2; echo "--- DETAIL ---"; curl -s localhost:3111/product/classic-sneakers | grep -o 'view-transition-name:[^;"]*' | head; echo "--- DETAIL status ---"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" localhost:3111/product/classic-sneakers; echo "--- errors in log ---"; grep -i "error\|undefined\|invalid" /tmp/next.log | head

cd /workspace; echo "--- DETAIL vt attrs ---"; curl -s localhost:3111/product/classic-sneakers | grep -o '<div [^>]*vt-[^>]*>' | head -6; echo; echo "--- HOME vt attrs (page + suspense wrappers) ---"; curl -s localhost:3111 | grep -o '<\(main\|div\) [^>]*vt-[^>]*>' | head -6; echo; echo "--- link transitionTypes reached client bundle? ---"; grep -rlo "nav-forward" .next/static/chunks/*.js 2>/dev/null | head -3; grep -rho "nav-forward\|nav-back" .next/static/chunks/*.js 2>/dev/null | sort -u

cd /workspace; echo "--- nav-forward/nav-back in home HTML (RSC payload) ---"; curl -s localhost:3111 | grep -o "nav-forward\|nav-back\|transitionTypes" | sort | uniq -c; echo "--- detail HTML ---"; curl -s localhost:3111/product/classic-sneakers | grep -o "nav-forward\|nav-back\|transitionTypes" | sort | uniq -c; echo "--- RSC payload context around nav-forward (home) ---"; curl -s localhost:3111 | grep -o '.\{140\}nav-forward.\{60\}' | head -2
cd /workspace; ls node_modules | grep -iE "playwright|puppeteer" | head; which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null | head

cd /workspace; mv react-canary.d.ts /tmp/react-canary.d.ts.bak; echo "=== tsc WITHOUT the shim ==="; npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -8; mv /tmp/react-canary.d.ts.bak react-canary.d.ts; echo "=== tsc WITH the shim ==="; npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -8; echo "(exit $?)"

cd /workspace; echo "=== next-env.d.ts ==="; cat next-env.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo "=== does next ref react/canary? ==="; grep -rn "react/canary" node_modules/next/dist/types/*.d.ts node_modules/next/types/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rln "react/canary" node_modules/next/ 2>/dev/null | head -5

cd /workspace; mv react-canary.d.ts /tmp/rc.bak; printf 'import { ViewTransition, NotARealExport } from "react"
const x: number = "definitely not a number"
export { ViewTransition, NotARealExport, x }
' > app/__tscheck.ts; npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -10; rm app/__tscheck.ts; mv /tmp/rc.bak react-canary.d.ts

cd /workspace; grep -rn "react/canary\|canary" .next/types/*.ts .next/dev/types/*.ts 2>/dev/null | head; echo "=== files in .next/types ==="; ls .next/types .next/dev/types 2>/dev/null; echo "=== grep whole .next for react/canary ==="; grep -rln "react/canary" .next/ 2>/dev/null | head

cd /workspace; mv react-canary.d.ts /tmp/rc.bak; rm -f .next/cache/.tsbuildinfo tsconfig.tsbuildinfo; echo "=== tsc WITHOUT shim (clean cache) ==="; npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -6; mv /tmp/rc.bak react-canary.d.ts; rm -f .next/cache/.tsbuildinfo tsconfig.tsbuildinfo; echo "=== tsc WITH shim (clean cache) ==="; npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -6; echo "(exit ${PIPESTATUS[0]:-0})"

cd /workspace; echo "=== count of ViewTransition per @types/react file ==="; grep -rc "ViewTransition" node_modules/@types/react/*.d.ts; echo "=== is it exported from index.d.ts? ==="; grep -n "ViewTransition" node_modules/@types/react/index.d.ts | head
cd /workspace; mv react-canary.d.ts /tmp/rc.bak; rm -f .next/cache/.tsbuildinfo; npx tsc --noEmit --explainFiles 2>/dev/null | grep -B4 -A2 "canary.d.ts" | head -30; mv /tmp/rc.bak react-canary.d.ts
cd /workspace; rm react-canary.d.ts; rm -f .next/cache/.tsbuildinfo; npx tsc --noEmit; echo "tsc exit: $?"
cd /workspace; npx next build 2>&1 | tail -12; echo "=== git status ==="; git status --short; echo "=== tsconfig diff ==="; git diff tsconfig.json
cd /workspace; cat .gitignore; rm -f tsconfig.tsbuildinfo

cd /workspace; pkill -f "next start" 2>/dev/null; rm -rf .next tsconfig.tsbuildinfo; npx next build 2>&1 | grep -E "Compiled|TypeScript|Failed|error|✓ Generating" ; echo "=== start & compare morph names ==="; (npx next start -p 3112 > /tmp/n2.log 2>&1 &); sleep 6; A=$(curl -s localhost:3112 | grep -o 'vt-name="product-image-classic-sneakers"' | head -1); B=$(curl -s localhost:3112/product/classic-sneakers | grep -o 'vt-name="product-image-classic-sneakers"' | head -1); echo "grid:   $A"; echo "detail: $B"; [ -n "$A" ] && [ "$A" = "$B" ] && echo "PAIRED ✅" || echo "MISMATCH ❌"; pkill -f "next start"; git status --short
cd /workspace; ls .next >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo ".next exists" || echo "no .next"; npx next build 2>&1 | grep -E "Compiled|TypeScript|Failed|error|Generating static"

cd /workspace; (npx next start -p 3113 > /tmp/n3.log 2>&1 &); sleep 6; A=$(curl -s localhost:3113 | grep -o 'vt-name="product-image-classic-sneakers"' | head -1); B=$(curl -s localhost:3113/product/classic-sneakers | grep -o 'vt-name="product-image-classic-sneakers"' | head -1); echo "grid:   [$A]"; echo "detail: [$B]"; if [ -n "$A" ] && [ "$A" = "$B" ]; then echo "PAIRED OK"; else echo "MISMATCH"; fi; curl -s localhost:3113/product/classic-sneakers | grep -c "nav-back"
cd /workspace; kill $(pgrep -f "port 3113\|3113" | head -5) 2>/dev/null; pgrep -af "next-server" | head -3; git status --short
cd /workspace; kill 1789 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; pgrep -c next-server || echo "server stopped"
cd /workspace; git diff --stat app/; echo "---"; git diff app/page.tsx app/ProductGrid.tsx
